decision: Does a bounded permutation-invariant set of the exact four-frame physical primitives already recorded for the observed shield add episode-stable h16 HIT prediction and exploratory current-action discrimination beyond the current scalar root?

evaluation.use: single post-selection evaluation on already observed L2d episodes; may select fresh confirmation but is not independent evidence

gate.current_action_signal: complete-episode bootstrap upper endpoint for object-full minus current-action-ablated object-set Brier is below zero with at least six of eight favorable episode directions
gate.low_propensity_action_signal: behavior-propensity-below-0.025 rows occur in all eight episodes, meet positive support, have object-full minus action-ablated bootstrap upper endpoint below zero, and at least six favorable directions
gate.nonbaseline_action_signal: known-nonbaseline rows occur in all eight episodes, meet positive support, have object-full minus action-ablated bootstrap upper endpoint below zero, and at least six favorable directions
gate.object_set_gain: complete-episode bootstrap upper endpoint for object-full minus same-capacity scalar-only Brier is below zero with at least six of eight favorable episode directions
gate.prefirst_hit_lifecycle: pre-first-HIT rows occur in all eight episodes, meet positive support, have object-full minus action-ablated bootstrap upper endpoint below zero, and at least six favorable directions
gate.primitive_contract: all train and evaluation rows match contract v1 and have zero cap-48 token truncation

hypotheses.H1_object_information: If the scalar counts and minimum-clearance summary discard local multi-hazard geometry needed for h16 risk, object-full will improve Brier over scalar-only with the same sigmoid DeepSets architecture, initialization, batch order, and rows.
hypotheses.H2_current_action_increment: If individual observed geometry supports an actionable local distinction, object-full will beat the same object set with exactly the nine current action-relative scalar fields zero-ablated.
hypotheses.H3_exploration_support: The current-action increment remains below propensity 0.025 and on actions known to differ from the reactive baseline, rather than occurring only on baseline-equal rows.
hypotheses.H4_lifecycle: The current-action increment remains before the first physical HIT and is not supported only by post-HIT lifecycle state.
hypotheses.H5_bounded_export: A cap-48 source-free physical token set, sub-10000-parameter sigmoid scorer, and batch-18 one-thread p99 below 5 ms provide a concrete immutable export-cost boundary without widening the shield.
hypotheses.H6_selection_limit: All L2d episodes and earlier hazard results have already been inspected. Passing may select an immutable primitive-set scorer for wholly fresh confirmation only; it cannot independently confirm, establish causal action value, promote a policy, or authorize value learning.

non_goals: no token-cap, primitive-horizon, architecture, width, depth, epoch, batch, optimizer, learning-rate, regularization, seed, pooling, normalization, loss, target, or model sweep
no new Wine episode, corpus mutation, exhaustive 640-bullet tensor, raw Bullet state/EX flag, sprite, slot, object identity, enemy program, ECL, RNG, source address, or future birth input
no history, recurrent state, attention, transformer, weighting, calibration fit, critic, actor, RL, IQL, CQL, OPE, active collection, or counterfactual successor
no behavior propensity, baseline identity, lifecycle label, absolute frame, stage, boss, spell, run identity, source, or future fact as a model input
no invented successor for an unexecuted action: the target and current action come only from factual executed Wine transitions
no causal action-effect, long-horizon action-value, HIT-reduction, NMNB, independent-confirmation, or online-execution claim
